facts.value: Reads packed commands from pobj->display using pobj->n_display << 5 as the command-loop length and a GX_VA_NULL-terminated vertex descriptor array to interpret attributes. Primitive and vertex-format bits feed GXBegin; position, normal, and NBT indices select caller-provided blended float data, while supported matrix, texture-coordinate, and color attributes are forwarded through matching GX calls. Each primitive advances the pointer and length counter by its consumed byte count. Replay stops at GX_NOP or when l + 3 < length is false. This checks command starts only: it does not validate that vertex payload reads remain inside the display-list allocation.

facts.value: Signature: static void setupShapeAnimVtxDesc(HSD_PObj* pobj). The argument references a polygon object whose pobj->verts points to a contiguous HSD_VtxDescList array terminated by an entry with attr == GX_VA_NULL. Entries provide attribute identifiers, delivery modes, component counts, component representations, and fractional precision.
